head: PulseO2 brings blood oxygen readings back to your Apple Watch face
dek: In the US, Apple Watch blood oxygen results only show in the Health app on iPhone; PulseO2 puts each new reading back on your watch face and in its app. It was #72 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 12 November.
details: It costs $4.99, with in-app purchases listed, by Get Happy, LLC, and needs iOS 26.
where: Apple Watch and iPhone, App Store, $4.99
means: US watch owners can see their oxygen level at a glance again.
todo: Find PulseO2 in the App Store and add its complication to your watch face.
thumb_words: BLOOD OXYGEN BACK ON THE WRIST
